Name: Stardew Kids Expansion Expansion
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
[size=3]I have absolutely been in love with the characters from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion[/url] since the moment I installed it. So in order to give myself some dialogue-writing practice, I've decided to edit & add to the existing dialogue from the mod![/size]

[size=4][b]:: Features ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds situational lines of dialogue that are absent in the original, such as rainy-day dialogue, Year 2 Green Rain, and reactions to dating/marrying various characters.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds Adrian, James, Tina, and Vanessa to [i]all[/i] festivals, including their year 2 variants. Douglas attends every festival except the Flower Dance and year 2 Luau. I also updated the kids' original festival data so they're no longer clipping into objects. [/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds Movie & Concession preferences for the theater, as well as unique dialogue for each film![/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adjusts some oddly-translated or inconsistent pieces of dialogue. Also changes some of the language characters use to make them sound more like kids. [/color][/*]
[*]Fixes some coding errors that resulted in some dialogues not being shown.[/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Changed some gift preferences to more accurately reflect character dialogue. I also added some more details just for fun, and some unique dialogue for specific items.[/color][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds some dialogue that varies based on which design you're using for Tina.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds a toggleabl[size=3]e "nickname mode" for Vanessa, in which Gus and James will refer to her as Nessa instead.[/size][/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][size=3]Adds a few lines of dialog[/size][/size][size=3]ue that mention [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295][size=3]Mr. Ginger[/size][/url][size=3] if you have that mod installed! [/size][size=1](I couldn't resist. I love him.)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Overall, I tried to give each character a bit more love and characterization. I made it a point not to [i]remove[/i] any traits from any character; I only added to what already existed.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]:: Compatibility ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Due to editing the gift reaction dialogues, this mod will probably conflict with any addons that adjust SKE characters' gift tastes directly.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]This addon retains support for both the female Wizard and "Pierre to Piper" mods. I've updated a few of their unique dialogue lines, but I don't actually have either installed, so they haven't been playtested. Please let me know if there are any issues![/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]I didn't touch any of the characters' schedules or rooms, so this mod should still be compatible with mods such as SVE, East Scarp, and the Little Red Schoolhouse.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]I haven't yet tested this mod with Diverse Stardew Valley. Nothing should specifically BREAK, but you may run into some issues with Tina's design-specific dialogue, since this mod only checks the config from SKE.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]:: Gifting Changes ::[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]All of the kids previously only hated beer, not ALL alcoholic beverages like Jas and Vincent. I fixed that, and gave them a shared reaction dialogue if you try to give them alcohol.[/*]
[*]Gave each of the kids a unique line of dialogue when gifted Stardrop Tea, like vanilla characters do.[/*]
[/list][left]Adrian:[/left]
[spoiler][left]Overall, Adrian didn't have a lot of unique gift preferences. I tried to fix that.[/left]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]Moved Pancakes from a liked gift to a loved gift.[/*]
[*]He also now loves raisins. It just felt right.[/*]
[*]Now likes Ancient Sword and Bone Flute, as well as the Price Catalogue.[/*]
[*]Neutral to Broken Glasses.[/*]
[*]Dislikes Yams and Autumn's Bounty.[/*]
[/list][left]Adrian reacts with unique dialogue to:[/left]
[list]
[*]Ancient Sword & Bone Flute[/*]
[*]Broken Glasses[/*]
[*]Price Catalogue[/*]
[*]Raisins[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[left][/left]
[left]Douglas:[/left]
[spoiler][left]Most of Douglas's list was left alone, since his gift preferences were the most fleshed out by far.[/left]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]Removed some duplicate entries.[/*]
[*]Now loves the books "Monster Compendium", "Book Of Stars", & "Friendship 101".[/*]
[*]Likes books "Raccoon Journal" & "Book Of Mystery".[/*]
[*]Moved Fairy Rose from Disliked to Neutral.[/*]
[/list][left]Douglas reacts with unique dialogue to:[/left]
[list]
[*]Void Egg, Void Mayo, & Fairy Rose[/*]
[*]Bone Flute[/*]
[*]Obsidian[/*]
[*]Bat Wing, Void Essence, Red Mushrooms, Purple Mushrooms & Void Salmon[/*]
[*]Rabbit's Foot[/*]
[*]"Monster Compendium", "Book Of Stars", "Friendship 101", "Raccoon Journal", & "Book Of Mystery"[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[left][/left]
[left]James:[/left]
[spoiler][left]Overall, a lot of James's Likes & Dislikes seemed to have been copied from Douglas's list, which I assume was an error. I took quite a few creative liberties here. [/left]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]Removed pretty much all of his existing likes (except for Joja Cola).[/*]
[*]Now loves chocolate cake (as he's mentioned to in his dialogue).[/*]
[*]Similarly, all flowers have been removed from James's disliked list. He now likes all wildflowers (Daffodils, Dandelions, Sweet Peas, and Crocus) and Poppies.[/*]
[*]Dislikes eggs.[/*]
[*]Hates all books EXCEPT "Monster Compendium" and "Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick", which are instead Liked.[/*]
[/list][left]James reacts with unique dialogue to:[/left]
[list]
[*]Eggs[/*]
[*]All Books[/*]
[*]All Flowers[/*]
[*]Joja Cola[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[left][/left]
[left]Tina:[/left]
[spoiler][left]Most of Tina's changes were just for sillies. She didn't really NEED the update, but I did it anyways.[/left]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]Now loves all of the doll artifacts, like Jas does.[/*]
[*]Likes Elvish Jewelry.[/*]
[*]Likes Cherry bombs and Explosive Ammo. I just thought it'd be funny.[/*]
[*]Likes all books.[/*]
[/list][left]Tina reacts with unique dialogue to:[/left]
[list]
[*]Dolls[/*]
[*]Cherry Bombs & Explosive Ammo[/*]
[*]Elvish Jewelry[/*]
[*]Potatoes[/*]
[*]All Books[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[left][/left]
[left]Vanessa:[/left]
[spoiler][left]Like Douglas, Vanessa seems to have a pretty thorough preference list by default. However, most of her liked gifts were already universally liked, so she didn't actually have a whole lot setting her apart from other characters.[/left]
[left][/left]
[list]
[*]Removed all Universal Likes from Vanessa's "liked" list, because it was a bit redundant.[/*]
[*]Loves Artichoke Dip (because she liked Artichokes before).[/*]
[*]Likes Sugar and Wheat Flour.[/*]
[*]Loves "Queen Of Sauce Cookbook".[/*]
[/list][left]Vanessa reacts with unique dialogue to:[/left]
[list]
[*]Sugar, Wheat Flour, and Oil[/*]
[*]All Metal Bars[/*]
[*]"Queen Of Sauce Cookbook"[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[left][/left]
